messages:
Olivia Park: hey devex, first day here! can't find the Templates area in the left sidebar. I can see /handbook but Templates isn't showing. anyone else see this? :confused:
Marco Li: welcome Olivia! :tada: sometimes the space is collapsed or you need to expand the Templates section. Try View > Show Templates or Search for 'PRD template'.
Olivia Park: tried Search; found the PRD but it's inside /handbook/international/templates/i18n-PRD and when I open it there's no 'Duplicate' or 'Copy to' option. link: https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/international/templates/i18n-PRD
docs-rotation: new org imports and new hires default to viewer role. I'll add you to docs-editors group now. If page-level copy is disabled we'll flip the toggle after that.
Olivia Park: thanks! quick follow-up: our team needs to add a "Localization notes" section to the PRD template. should we edit the canonical template or make a localized variant?
Marco Li: prefer to create a team-specific variant under /handbook/templates/international (avoid touching the canonical shared template unless it's a cross-team change). Duplicate -> edit in personal workspace -> move to /handbook/drafts -> open a docs PR for reviews.
Olivia Park: got it — duplicate to My workspace, edit, then move to drafts. what's the naming convention for i18n drafts? other repos use locale suffixes.
docs-bot: Naming rule: use YYYY.MM.team.locale.short-title, e.g., 2026.03.international.eu-de-PRD. Add an "Owner:" and "Reviewers:" header at the top. When you open a PR the CI runs link-check and linter.
Olivia Park: when I try to move my draft into /handbook/drafts Notion says "Cannot move to that workspace." who do I ping for that?
Riley Nguyen: that usually means the page is still in your personal workspace or you picked the wrong destination. From your duplicated page: • Click • Move to • choose "Redwood" workspace • then pick /handbook/drafts. If the destination is missing I can move it for you.
Olivia Park: ok I asked Riley and they moved it for me. thanks! final q: do we have style/lint rules for template copy (tone, terminology)?
Marco Li: yes — see /handbook/style/voice-and-terms for tone. For automated checks, include a short YAML header in the Notion draft when you submit the PR. The docs repo linter flags disallowed terms and missing sections. Avoid brand-new jargon without a glossary entry.
Olivia Park: perfect, that answers everything. really appreciate the fast help :heart:
i18n-bot: Tip: For localization docs include a top-line "Locale:" metadata and avoid hard-coded screenshots. See /handbook/i18n-guidelines for more details.
